# GNU libidn2

The MSYS2 UCRT64 build bundles `libidn2-0.dll` as a libcurl dependency.
The package used for ImGui Studio 1.0.0 is
[`mingw-w64-ucrt-x86_64-libidn2` 2.3.8-4](https://packages.msys2.org/packages/mingw-w64-ucrt-x86_64-libidn2).
The library is available under GPL-2.0-or-later or LGPL-3.0-or-later.

The notices in this directory come from the
[GNU libidn2 2.3.8 release](https://ftp.gnu.org/gnu/libidn/libidn2-2.3.8.tar.gz).
The [MSYS2 source package](https://mirror.msys2.org/mingw/sources/mingw-w64-libidn2-2.3.8-4.src.tar.zst)
includes the recipe and patches for this build.
